name: Organizations — tenant model, org dashboard, billing, consent, consultancy, services

epics.name: Organization model & tenancy
epics.goal: Real orgs, memberships, roles, 404-style isolation and an audit trail; the /org shell gated on membership instead of any session.

epics.name: Onboarding & invites
epics.goal: A workspace in under two minutes on a phone: three screens to a paid org, then link/QR, email and CSV invites that all end at one consent screen.

epics.name: Catalog & entitlements for orgs
epics.goal: Org products and prices in the catalog, org_assignment rows that own entitlement grants, highest-limit stacking, features on the version endpoint.

epics.name: Org billing
epics.goal: Setup fee, one Stripe subscription per org with one item per price, prorated adds, end-of-period removals, Stripe dunning, invoices mirror — webhook-only writes.

epics.name: Team & members
epics.goal: Members, roles, groups, support owners, pending invites and per-person item assignment, all consent-scoped.

epics.name: Consent, privacy & member side
epics.goal: NONE/SUMMARY/FULL data_share owned by the person, instant revocation, GDPR export/erasure, honest 'what they see' screens.

epics.name: Dashboard & analytics
epics.goal: Defined metrics, nightly rollups, k-anonymity suppression, a live dashboard and analytics with export and scheduled reports.

epics.name: Applications, opportunities, interviews, resumes (consent-scoped)
epics.goal: Rewire the four content pages to real, consent-scoped data and retire sample-data.ts.

epics.name: Human services marketplace
epics.goal: Experts, orders, checkout, expert portal, disputes, record-only payout ledger, org-bought services.

epics.name: Consultancy Marketer
epics.goal: MARKETER role paired to consultants with FULL consent: resumes made on their behalf, job bank and batches, marketer inbox — and a structural no-submit guarantee.

epics.name: Consultancy Ops add-on
epics.goal: Timesheets, placements, invoice records, payments and profit for consultancies — record money, never move it; FINANCE role.

epics.name: Integrations (honest)
epics.goal: Replace the fictional integrations page with what is real (extension, inboxes) and buildable without OAuth: Slack webhook, ICS feed, outbound webhooks, API key.

epics.name: Settings, notifications, security
epics.goal: Org profile, notification rules with digests and quiet hours, audit viewer, honest security tab, close-org flow.

epics.name: Marketing & sales
epics.goal: An honest /organizations page with self-serve start, a price calculator, inquiry-to-org conversion and org terms.

epics.name: Mobile, accessibility, performance, QA
epics.goal: 390px-first org surfaces (bottom tabs, cards), skeletons, a11y pass, dark mode, e2e suite in CI.

stories.title: Org core schema — organization, org_member, org_group, org_invite_batch, org_join_code, org_domain, org_audit_event
stories.story: As the API, I want the organization tables so that every org story has a home and the isolation rules have something to enforce.
stories.genz: Nothing visible yet — but it is what makes 'your org pays, you keep your account' true instead of a slogan.
ac: Additive Liquibase changelog 20261011010000_org_core.xml creates the seven tables exactly as docs/design/org/tenant-model.md §2 (columns, generated unique keys active_key/active_user_key, indexes).
JPA entities + repositories under domain.org / repository.org; every repository query method takes orgId except findMine(userId).
organization.type rejects COACH and org_member.role rejects COACH at the service layer (reserved).
Liquibase runs clean on an empty DB and on a DB at 20261011010000_app_setting.xml.
tests: Liquibase migration test (existing pattern) passes.
OrgRepositoryContractTest (reflection) asserts the orgId-first rule.
Entity round-trip test for generated keys: two live rows with the same (org, email) fail; INVITED → LEFT then re-invite succeeds.
stories.tech: api/src/main/resources/config/liquibase/changelog/, api/src/main/java/com/dossier/api/domain/org/*, repository/org/*. Mirror Subscription.java style (VARCHAR status, Instant timestamps).

stories.title: OrgAccessService — role→permission matrix, require(orgId, permission), 404 for foreign orgs
stories.story: As the platform, I want one place that decides what an org actor may do so that no endpoint can forget to check.
stories.genz: Privacy you can trust is a boring class with a complete test matrix, not a settings toggle.
ac: OrgRole enum {OWNER, ADMIN, STAFF, MEMBER, MARKETER, FINANCE, COACH} with permissions() per tenant-model.md §4.
OrgAccessService.require(orgId, OrgPermission) returns OrgMembership or throws OrgNotFoundException → 404 whose body never says 'forbidden'.
@OrgPermissionRequired annotation + a WebMvc test that fails for any /api/orgs/** handler lacking it.
Platform ROLE_ADMIN gets no access through /api/orgs/**.
tests: OrgPermissionMatrixTest table-driven over every (role, permission) cell.
Handler-annotation reflection test.
Foreign org → 404 unit test.
stories.tech: api/.../security/org/OrgAccessService.java, OrgPermission.java, OrgRole.java; SecurityUtils.getCurrentUserLogin() for the principal.

stories.title: Org endpoints — POST /api/orgs (DRAFT), GET /mine, GET/PATCH /{orgId}, POST /close, groups CRUD
stories.story: As an organizer, I want to create and configure my org so that the web flows have an API.
stories.genz: Create an org from a phone in one request; no sales call required to get a DRAFT.
ac: POST /api/orgs creates DRAFT org + OWNER membership; slug derived/validated; type required; COACH rejected 422.
GET /api/orgs/mine returns memberships with role, status, memberCount.
GET /api/orgs/{id} returns org + my role + permissions[]; PATCH validates settings_json via OrgSettings record.
POST /close (OWNER) → CLOSED, ends grants now (hook for O4.9), audited.
Groups CRUD with unique (org, name).
tests: OrgResourceIT: create, mine, patch validation, close permissions.
Slug collision → 409 with suggestion.

stories.title: org_audit_event + OrgAuditService with action constants
stories.story: As a member, I want every org action about me recorded so that 'what did my org do' has an answer.
stories.genz: Receipts. Gen Z asks 'who looked at my stuff' — this is the table that answers.
ac: OrgAuditService.record(orgId, action, targetType, targetLogin, targetId, details) appends a row keyed by login strings.
No update/delete methods on the repository (test).
Action constants listed in tenant-model.md §2.7 exist.
tests: Append-only repository test.
Every mutating OrgResource test asserts one audit row (shared helper).

stories.title: OrgIsolationIT — route-discovered cross-tenant test (ROADMAP 21.0 gate)
stories.story: As the business, I want proof one org cannot read another's data so that we can sell to schools and consultancies.
stories.genz: Trust is the product. A bootcamp's roster must never leak to another bootcamp — and we prove it on every build.
ac: Testcontainers MySQL IT seeds orgs A and B; enumerates every /api/orgs/{orgId}/** route via RequestMappingHandlerMapping; calls each as B's owner with A's ids → 404.
Asserts no org_audit_event for org A has actor from B.
New routes fail until they comply (no hand-written route list).
Runs in CI integrationTest job.
tests: The IT itself; a deliberately unscoped test route in the test profile is caught (meta-test).

stories.title: Web gate — (org)/layout.tsx uses /api/orgs/mine, role redirects, last-org cookie, feature flag
stories.story: As a signed-in user, I want /org to open only when I am an org admin/staff so that the console is real, not a demo any account can see.
stories.genz: No dead ends: a member who lands on /org is sent to their dashboard with a one-line explanation, not a 403 wall.
ac: Layout calls /api/orgs/mine after the account probe; none → /org/new; MEMBER-only → /dashboard with toast; several → kiwiply_org cookie picks, switcher available.
dossier.orgs.enabled=false keeps today's redirect behaviour and noindex.
Remove the 'any signed-in user' comment and sample ORG constant usage in the layout path.
tests: Layout unit tests for the four branches (mock serverApiFetch).
npm test -w web green.
stories.tech: web/src/app/(org)/layout.tsx, web/src/lib/site.ts NON_INDEXABLE_PATHS, new web/src/lib/org.ts (cookie + fetch helpers).
evidence: web/src/app/(org)/layout.tsx (session-only gate, comment says no org model)

stories.title: OrgChip real + org switcher sheet + role-aware nav in OrgShell
stories.story: As a staff member in two orgs, I want to switch orgs and see only the nav my role allows.
stories.genz: A bottom-sheet switcher with the org logos — one thumb, no page reload confusion.
ac: OrgChip shows real name/type/status chip; tap opens a bottom sheet (mobile) / menu (desktop) listing memberships; selecting sets the cookie and refreshes.
NAV filtered by permissions[] from GET /api/orgs/{id}; MARKETER/FINANCE see their navs.
Bell badge reads real unread count (O13.3) or hides; role label shows the real role.
tests: Shell renders nav per role fixture (OWNER, STAFF, FINANCE, MARKETER).
Switcher a11y: focus trap, Escape, 44px items.

stories.title: Demo org seed for demo accounts (labelled)
stories.story: As sales, I want the demo login to open a believable, labelled demo org so that demos keep working after sample data is deleted.
stories.genz: Honesty badge on demo data — we never pass fake numbers as real.
ac: DemoAccountService seeds org demo-bootcamp (BOOTCAMP, ACTIVE via dev flag) with 12 synthetic members, groups, scopes mixed (SUMMARY/NONE), when demo accounts are enabled.
Demo org is read-only via DemoGuard; DemoBadge shows in OrgShell.
Seed is idempotent.
tests: Seed idempotency test; DemoGuard blocks mutations in the demo org.

stories.title: /org/new — three-screen create flow (name+type → about you → pay) at 390px
stories.story: As a bootcamp ops lead on my phone, I want to create our workspace in under two minutes so that I can start inviting a cohort today.
stories.genz: Chips not dropdowns, one question per screen, Apple/Google Pay — the whole thing feels like signing up for an app, not procurement.
ac: Three screens per onboarding-invites.md §2 with 44px chips, inline slug, 16+ attestation for Bootcamp/University.
Screen 3 calls POST /api/orgs then POST .../billing/setup-fee {CARD}; 'Send me an invoice instead' → INVOICE; 'Skip for now' → DRAFT console with pinned pay banner.
Analytics events org_create_started/step/setup_fee_started emitted.
tests: Component tests for each screen's validation; e2e create→Checkout redirect with a stubbed API.
Lighthouse a11y ≥ 95 on /org/new.
stories.tech: web/src/app/(org)/org/new/page.tsx (outside the org gate: needs session only), components/org-v2/onboarding/*.

stories.title: Email invites — POST /members/invite, invite email, GET /api/join/{token}, POST accept
stories.story: As an admin, I want to invite people by email so that they can join with one tap and keep their own account.
stories.genz: One email, one button, an honest 'Not you? ignore us' line. No account created for you behind your back.
ac: Invite creates org_member INVITED with hashed token, 14-day expiry; ≤200 emails per call; response lists invited/invalid/alreadyMember.
Email via MailService contains org name, inviter, what the org pays for, expiry, 'Not you?' line.
GET /api/join/{token} is public and returns preview only; POST /accept requires auth, activates the membership, writes data_share (O6.2) and assignment grants (O3.2).
Members blocked while org not ACTIVE (409 SEAT_STATE); admins allowed (≤3) in DRAFT.
tests: Invite/accept IT incl. expiry, reuse, wrong user email mismatch allowed (any signed-in account may accept — invites bind to the accepting user).
Email template snapshot.

stories.title: Join pages — /join/{slug}/{code} and /join/t/{token}: preview → sign-in handoff → consent → done
stories.story: As an invited person, I want to see who invited me and what they will see before I join, then finish in three taps.
stories.genz: The consent screen is the hero: plain words, two options, no dark patterns, celebration at the end.
ac: Public preview renders org logo/name/role/payer line; CTA goes through /login or /signup with return URL.
Consent screen per consent-data-sharing.md §5.1 (SUMMARY default, NONE option, 'What exactly?' sheet).
Done screen offers extension + resume CTAs; member lands on /dashboard.
join_preview_viewed/join_accepted/join_abandoned events.
tests: e2e join as new and existing user; consent choice persisted (GET /api/me/orgs).
390px: no horizontal scroll, targets ≥44px.
stories.tech: web/src/app/join/**, components/org-join/*; reuse auth return-URL plumbing in web/src/proxy.ts.

stories.title: Join codes — create/revoke, QR + share sheet, redemption endpoint
stories.story: As a career-centre staffer in a classroom, I want a QR code students scan to join so that nobody types emails.
stories.genz: Scan, sign in with Google, tap Join — done before the lecturer finishes the slide.
ac: POST/GET/DELETE /api/orgs/{id}/join-codes with maxUses/expiry/groupId; MEMBER role only.
POST /api/join/code/{code} redeems through the consent screen; counts uses; revoked/expired → clear error page.
Web: full-screen QR view, Copy link, Web Share API on phones, live use counter.
tests: JoinCodeTest: max uses, expiry, revoke, MEMBER-only.
QR view has the code as text for screen readers.
stories.tech: OrgJoinCodeResource; web components/org-v2/team/JoinCodeSheet.tsx; QR via a tiny inline generator (no new heavy dep without asking).

stories.title: CSV / paste import with validation, 20% rule, pre-assign column, org_invite_batch
stories.story: As an admin with a roster, I want to import a CSV and see exactly which rows failed so that onboarding 200 people takes minutes.
stories.genz: Drag a file, see a live preview with red rows you can fix inline — no 'upload failed' mystery.
ac: POST /members/import multipart ≤2,000 rows; columns email (req), name, group, support_owner_email, plan; 422 with row numbers; >20% invalid aborts unless force=true.
Creates org_invite_batch; team page shows 'x of y joined' per batch.
plan column pre-assigns items (PENDING_ACCEPT).
tests: CsvImportTest fixtures (BOM, quotes, duplicates, invalid plan).
Web: preview table with errors in a live region.
stories.tech: OrgImportService (OpenCSV already available? else Java built-in parsing), web components/org-v2/team/ImportSheet.tsx.

stories.title: Domain verification (TXT/email) + auto-join card for verified emails
stories.story: As a university, I want students with @uni.edu emails offered to join so that we never upload a roster.
stories.genz: Students opt in from their own dashboard; the school never gets a list of who didn't.
ac: POST/GET/DELETE /domains; verification by DNS TXT _kiwiply-verify.{domain} or postmaster email; one org per domain.
With auto_join, activated users whose email matches see a dashboard card → consent screen → MEMBER.
Admins cannot list non-joined matching users.
tests: DomainVerifyTest with a stubbed resolver; auto-join card only for activated matching emails.
stories.tech: OrgDomainResource, DnsVerifier (dnsjava or JNDI), web dashboard card in the user app (coordinate with U area layout).

stories.title: Activation checklist — GET /onboarding + dashboard empty state replacing sample stats
stories.story: As a new admin, I want a live checklist so that I always know the next step and when the workspace is really working.
stories.genz: Progress bars and ticks, live counts ('38 of 60 joined'), deep links — gamified but useful.
ac: GET /api/orgs/{id}/onboarding returns the seven items with done flags and counts per onboarding-invites.md §5.
Dashboard renders the checklist until complete, then the live dashboard (O7.4).
No sample stats render for a real org.
tests: Checklist computation unit tests; web renders both states.

stories.title: /org/welcome — post-checkout polling page (never fake-green)
stories.story: As a payer, I want to see my workspace confirmed only when the payment really landed.
stories.genz: A mascot 'confirming…' state for up to 30 s, then confetti — or an honest 'we'll email you'.
ac: Polls GET /api/orgs/{id} every 2 s ≤30 s; ACTIVE → confetti + checklist; else honest fallback copy.
Return URL never activates anything.
tests: Component test for the three states.

stories.title: Member activation nudge (one in-app + one email) and admin 'copy reminder'
stories.story: As a member who joined but did nothing, I want one gentle nudge — and my org admin gets a message to send themselves, not a spam cannon.
stories.genz: Notification etiquette: one nudge, then silence. Pressure comes from a human, not from us.
ac: Job: 3 days after join without activation → one Notification + one email; never repeated.
Team page 'haven't started' filter with a 'Copy reminder message' button (text only).
tests: Nudge job idempotency; copy text snapshot.

stories.title: Onboarding analytics events (server-side, no PII) + p50 time-to-activate report
stories.story: As the product team, I want to measure name→paid time so that the two-minute promise is checked, not assumed.
stories.genz: We measure speed because the audience abandons slow flows silently.
ac: Events in onboarding-invites.md §7 recorded (hashed org id); admin analytics shows p50/p90 org_create_started→org_activated and join funnel.
tests: Event emission tests; aggregation query test.
stories.tech: Reuse AdminAnalyticsResource storage; coordinate with A area for the admin chart.

stories.title: Org product/price seeds in the catalog (Pro $24.99, Autopilot $49.99, AI Interview $9.99, Marketer $29.99, Setup $499, Ops rows)
stories.story: As the catalog, I want the org rows so that assignments and Stripe items have something to point at.
stories.genz: Prices live in data so they can change without a release — and the pricing page always tells the truth.
ac: Seeds product/product_price (audience ORG, interval MONTH / ONE_TIME) and product_entitlement rows per ROADMAP tables incl. marketer keys (org.marketer, consultants.max=10, assignments.open_max=100, ai.budget_cents_per_period=400).
Requires Phase 18.1 tables (admin area); if absent, this story blocks and says so.
tests: Seed test asserting prices and entitlement keys.
stories.tech: Depends on Phase 18.1 schema owned by the admin area (A*); coordinate IDs. Liquibase data changelog.

stories.title: org_assignment table + OrgAssignmentService creating/ending entitlement_grant rows
stories.story: As an admin, I want to give a person Pro or Autopilot so that their extension unlocks within a minute.
stories.genz: Your org taps once; your extension says 'Pro via Acme' before you finish your coffee.
ac: Schema per billing.md §3.1 incl. live_key uniqueness; statuses PENDING_ACCEPT/ACTIVE/ENDING/ENDED.
Create → grant (source ORG_ASSIGNMENT, org_id) when member ACTIVE; on invite accept PENDING_ACCEPT→ACTIVE + grant.
End → ends_at = period end (or now for erasure), grant ends_at mirrored; upgrade supersedes.
Stripe step (O4.4) runs before the grant; failure leaves no row.
tests: OrgAssignmentServiceTest cases in billing.md §10.

stories.title: EntitlementService.resolve over grants — highest-limit stacking, org budget period, plan label 'via org'
stories.story: As a user with personal Pro and an org Autopilot seat, I want the best of each limit, never the sum, and the right budget period.
stories.genz: No surprise paywalls: whichever plan is better for you wins, automatically.
ac: resolve(login) unions active grants; numeric limits max, booleans OR; AI budget period follows the winning grant (org subscription period for ORG_ASSIGNMENT).
isPro ≡ has('ai.server'); PRO_REQUIRED kept, PLAN_REQUIRED {feature} added.
Existing EntitlementServiceTest matrix still green (behaviour identical for personal subs).
tests: Extend EntitlementServiceTest: stacking, org period, grant end fallback.
stories.tech: api/.../service/EntitlementService.java (replace subscription-only logic per Phase 18.2, admin area may own the base refactor — coordinate).

stories.title: GET /api/profile/version adds via{orgId, orgName}; extension shows 'Pro via Acme'
stories.story: As a member, I want the extension to tell me my org covers my plan so that I understand why features unlocked.
stories.genz: Transparent status in the drawer header, not a mystery upgrade.
ac: Version DTO gains via; extension drawer/options show the label; no extra network call.
Extension manifest version bumped (wxt.config.ts + package.json).
tests: ProfileResource test; extension jsdom test for the label.
stories.tech: api web/rest/ProfileResource.java; job-autofill entrypoints/panel + options; tracking.js DTO.

stories.title: Personal + org stacking notice (ORG_COVERS_YOUR_PLAN) with portal link — we never cancel for them
stories.story: As someone already paying for Pro, I want to be told my org now covers it and how to cancel mine if I want.
stories.genz: Saving people money unprompted is the fastest trust win there is.
ac: One-time Notification + email when an org grant covers an existing personal grant; link to the existing Stripe portal session.
Never cancels or modifies the personal subscription.
tests: Fires once per (user, org); not for Free users.
stories.tech: OrgAssignmentService hook; BillingResource portal endpoint exists.

stories.title: Margin guard rules for org/service prices — per-invoice Stripe allocation, +25% warning, coaching payout $78
stories.story: As the admin publishing a price, I want the guard to compute org and service margins the way we actually get charged.
stories.genz: Fair prices that keep the lights on — the guard is why we can promise no sudden hikes.
ac: MarginGuard implements billing.md §7 and services-marketplace.md §7 tables; refuses <80%/<20% without override reason; +25% org/individual relation is a warning.
tests: MarginGuardTest table-driven incl. AI Interview $9.99 pass and $9.98 fail; coaching payout $80 fails, $78 passes.
stories.tech: Guard class lives with Phase 18.4 (admin area); this story contributes the rule-set + tests.

stories.title: Org Stripe customer + setup-fee Checkout (payment mode, Stripe Tax, tax-id collection) via StripeGateway
stories.story: As an OWNER, I want to pay the $499 with a card or Apple Pay so that the workspace activates without a sales cycle.
stories.genz: Apple Pay in 20 seconds; a receipt in the inbox; the org is live.
ac: POST /api/orgs/{id}/billing/setup-fee {CARD} creates the org customer (metadata kiwiply_scope=org, org_id) if missing, then a Checkout session mode=payment with client_reference_id org:{id}; org → PENDING_SETUP_FEE.
New StripeGateway methods: createOrgCustomer, createOneTimeCheckout; only StripeGatewayImpl imports com.stripe.
Billing off → 503 BILLING_DISABLED unless dossier.orgs.dev-activate.
tests: Gateway stub tests; state transition test; disabled-billing path.

stories.title: Setup fee via Stripe Invoice (send_invoice, bank transfer) + 14-day abandonment job
stories.story: As a university finance office, I want an invoice I can pay by bank transfer.
stories.genz: Institutions pay by invoice; students never see this — but it unblocks the school deal.
ac: {INVOICE} creates a Stripe invoice with the setup price, days_until_due 15, hosted URL returned and emailed to billing_email.
Nightly job: PENDING_SETUP_FEE older than 14 days with no payment → DRAFT, invoice voided.
tests: Gateway stub; job test.

stories.title: OrgBillingWebhookHandler — routing by customer scope, setup paid → ACTIVE, mirrors for subscription/items/invoices
stories.story: As the system, I want Stripe events to be the only writer of org billing state so that money and entitlements never disagree.
stories.genz: Boring and bulletproof: the same idempotent pipeline that already runs personal billing.
ac: BillingWebhookService.applyInTx routes org-scoped events (customer metadata or organization.stripe_customer_id) to the handler; per-user path unchanged.
Handles the table in billing.md §5; idempotency/ordering/record-then-apply reused; stripe_event.org_id set.
Creates the empty org subscription on activation.
tests: OrgBillingWebhookHandlerTest cases in billing.md §10; existing BillingWebhookService tests unchanged and green.
stories.tech: service/billing/BillingWebhookService.java, new OrgBillingWebhookHandler; domain OrgSubscription, OrgSubscriptionItem, OrgInvoice; changelog 20261011020000_org_billing.xml.

stories.title: Subscription item quantities — assign (+1, create_prorations) / unassign (−1, none, grant to period end)
stories.story: As an org, I want adding a person mid-month to cost the remaining days and removing one to simply stop next month.
stories.genz: No refunds, no gotchas, clearly explained in the UI before you tap.
ac: StripeGateway.setItemQuantity(subscriptionId, priceId, delta, proration) creates the item if missing.
Assign runs Stripe before writing the grant; Stripe failure → 502 and no row.
Unassign: ends_at = current_period_end, quantity −1 with proration none; nightly ENDING→ENDED.
tests: Sequence tests incl. failure rollback; period-end job.

stories.title: Dunning — PAST_DUE on payment_failed, SUSPENDED on unpaid/canceled (grants end), re-activate on invoice.paid, notifications
stories.story: As a member, I want to keep working while my org sorts out a card problem, and to be told clearly if the plan pauses.
stories.genz: Nobody loses access on the first failed charge; messages say what happens and when.
ac: State moves per tenant-model.md §3 and billing.md §5; grants ends_at=now on SUSPENDED; re-open as new grants on payment.
Emails to billing contacts; Notifications to OWNER/ADMIN/FINANCE and ORG_PAUSED to members.
tests: Handler tests for each transition; member notification once per event.

stories.title: Billing page real — GET /billing (upcoming invoice, items, invoices mirror) replacing the Enterprise sample
stories.story: As an admin, I want to see what next month costs and download past invoices from the page.
stories.genz: One card: next invoice amount + breakdown; invoices as a tappable list; no 'Enterprise plan' fiction.
ac: GET /api/orgs/{id}/billing per billing.md §9; upcoming from gateway.upcomingInvoice.
Page layout per §9 wireframe at 390px; Download opens invoice_pdf_url; 'Enterprise/Annual contract/Visa 4242' sample removed.
tests: DTO test; web renders with fixture; empty state for DRAFT org.

stories.title: Payment method & tax ID via Stripe Portal (invoice-customer config) + billing contacts
stories.story: As a FINANCE user, I want to update the card, tax ID and who gets invoices without emailing support.
stories.genz: Stripe's portal does the secure bits; we never see or store card numbers.
ac: POST /billing/portal returns a portal session for the org customer (cancel disabled in the portal config).
Billing contacts CRUD (members or plain emails) stored on the org; invoice emails cc them.
tests: Portal permission test (OWNER/ADMIN/FINANCE only).
stories.tech: StripeGateway.createPortalSession reused with the org customer; org_billing_contact table (small, in org_billing changelog).

stories.title: OrgSeatReconciler nightly — assignment counts vs Stripe quantities, alert on drift (never auto-fix money)
stories.story: As ops, I want to know the day billing and grants disagree.
stories.genz: Quiet when right, loud when wrong — the way billing should be.
ac: Job compares per price; writes an admin-queue alert with both numbers; ops add-on quantity (O11.8) is the one derived quantity it sets.
tests: Drift fixture → alert; no drift → nothing.
stories.tech: OrgSeatReconciler @Scheduled; admin alert via the A-area queue table (or SalesInquiry-style row until it exists).

stories.title: Leave / remove / erase end assignments correctly (period end vs now) and anonymise membership on erasure
stories.story: As a person who deletes my account, I want my org seat to vanish with me and my org to stop paying for it.
stories.genz: Delete means delete — for the org record about you too.
ac: AccountDeletionService ends assignments now, sets org_member ERASED (user_id NULL, email NULL), deletes data_share, writes MEMBER_ERASED.
Leave/remove → period end with end_reason; sole-OWNER erasure → org SUSPENDED + admin alert.
tests: ErasureAnonymisesMembershipTest; leave vs remove reasons.

stories.title: Dev/CI billing-off path (dossier.orgs.dev-activate) + Stripe test-clock runbook

ac: Generate DRAFT from approved+uninvoiced timesheets; ISSUED/VOID; PDF via the resume-builder Chromium sidecar (R0.6) with disclaimer footer; paid_minor derived from payments.
tests: InvoiceGenerateTest; PaidDerivationTest; PDF footer present.

stories.title: Payments (IN/OUT) and expenses recorded by hand, linked to invoices/placements
stories.story: As finance, I want to record what came in and went out without ever typing an account number.
stories.genz: Memo fields only; the validator refuses anything that looks like an account.
ac: Tables per §2; reference validated; invoice status recomputed.
tests: SensitiveTextValidatorTest on reference; status recompute.

stories.title: Profit view (by consultant/client/month) + CSV/PDF exports, audited finance reads
stories.story: As an owner, I want billed − paid − expenses by consultant, client and month, and to export everything.
stories.genz: Never locked in: export is one tap.
ac: GET /ops/profit per §4; exports per §5; OPS_READ_FINANCE/OPS_EXPORT audit; disclaimer on screen and footer.
tests: ProfitViewTest fixture book; audit rows.

stories.title: Ops add-on billing — base $99 + $4 per active consultant via nightly derived quantity
stories.story: As the business, I want the add-on billed by active consultants automatically.
stories.genz: Pay for who is actually placed, not for seats you don't use.
ac: Catalog rows; OrgSeatReconciler sets the consultant quantity nightly; invoice line descriptions clear.
tests: OpsQuantityReconcilerTest.

stories.title: Retention (7y) and erasure behaviour for ops records; disclaimer component
stories.story: As a consultancy, I want records kept as long as the law expects and former consultants anonymised, not deleted from the books.
stories.genz: Your name leaves; the org's numbers stay anonymous — fair to both.
ac: Erasure keeps ops rows under 'Former consultant #id'; retention job after CLOSED+7y; shared Disclaimer component in @kiwiply/ui used on every finance screen.
tests: Erasure test; retention job dry-run.

stories.title: Honest integrations page — Connected (extension, inbox counts) / Available / Not planned; remove fictional apps
stories.story: As an admin, I want to know what Kiwiply actually connects to.
stories.genz: No fake 'Connected' badges — credibility is the brand.
ac: GET /integrations returns counts; page per integrations.md §6; sample INTEGRATIONS/AUTOMATION_FLOWS/API_ACCESS_ROWS/NOTIFICATION_ROUTES removed.
tests: Counts computed from fill_event/inbox_connection; page fixture.

stories.title: Slack incoming webhook — paste URL, pick events, test message, digests
stories.story: As a bootcamp team living in Slack, I want joins, placements and billing alerts in our channel.
stories.genz: Where the team already is; no bot install, just a URL.
ac: Encrypted URL (SecretBox), SSRF guard, events per §4, weekly digest; failures surfaced.
tests: SlackWebhookSendTest; SSRF rejection.

stories.title: Calendar ICS feed — admin feed (counts) and member own feed; revoke
stories.story: As staff, I want interview load in my calendar; as a member, my own interviews in mine.
stories.genz: Subscribe once, works in Apple/Google/Outlook, no permissions granted to us.
ac: /ics/{token}.ics per §3; admin feed all-day counts; member feed real events (user area data); revoke → 404.
tests: IcsFeedTest.
stories.tech: IcsFeedResource (public, token auth); ical generation inline.

stories.title: Outbound webhooks — HMAC signature, retries, deliveries log, auto-disable
stories.story: As a consultancy with its own tools, I want events pushed to my endpoint.
stories.genz: Developer-friendly: signed JSON, replayable deliveries list.
ac: Per §3–4; payloads ids+display names only; consent-scoped.
tests: WebhookSignatureTest; retry schedule; disable after 50 failures.

stories.title: Org API key + public read API (/api/v1/org/*) with identical suppression and scopes
stories.story: As a university data team, I want to pull our summary metrics into our own dashboards.
stories.genz: Data portability for institutions without a sales engineer.
ac: Hashed keys shown once; scopes; 60/min rate limit; DTOs reuse UI services so consent/suppression is identical.
tests: ApiKeyAuthTest; DTO parity test.

stories.title: Org profile settings real — name, type, logo upload (S3, ≤2MB), website, timezone, billing email, defaults
stories.story: As an admin, I want to set our logo and defaults so invites and pages look like us.
stories.genz: Logo shows on the join screen — students recognise their school instantly.
ac: PATCH /api/orgs/{id} + logo upload endpoint (sanitised, presigned read); settings form at 390px; sample ABOUT_COMPANY/INDUSTRIES removed; 'Coming soon' tabs removed in favour of real tabs (Profile, Roles, Notifications, Domains, Security, Audit).
tests: Upload validation; settings persistence.

stories.title: Notification rules — per-event channel (in-app / email digest / Slack), digest day/time, quiet hours
stories.story: As an admin, I want to choose what reaches me and when.
stories.genz: Quiet hours by default; digests over drips.
ac: settings_json rules validated; UI toggles per event; defaults: digest weekly, quiet 21:00–08:00 org-local.
tests: Rule evaluation tests; quiet hours delay.

stories.title: Org notification kinds + delivery (Notification rows for members/admins, batched daily digest email job)
stories.story: As a member, I want to hear from my org through Kiwiply at most once a day unless it is urgent.
stories.genz: Notification etiquette as a system rule, not per-feature goodwill.
ac: Kinds ORG_ACTIVE, INVITE_ACCEPTED (batched), INVITES_EXPIRING, SHARE_REVOKED, BILLING_*, ORG_ITEM_GRANTED, ORG_COVERS_YOUR_PLAN, ORG_PAUSED, ORG_GET_STARTED; digest job; at most one org email/day/member.
tests: Batching; daily cap; kinds registered with the existing NotificationResource.

stories.title: Audit log viewer (OWNER/ADMIN/FINANCE) with filters and CSV
stories.story: As an owner, I want to see who did what in our workspace.
stories.genz: Transparency inside the org too — staff actions are visible to owners.
ac: GET /audit paged + filters; Settings → Audit tab; export CSV (audited).
tests: Permission; filter query.

stories.title: Security tab honest — real status (admins with 2FA/passkey, sessions), optional 'require 2FA for admins' once user 2FA exists
stories.story: As an owner, I want the security page to say what is true about our workspace.
stories.genz: No 'AES-256 / SSO enabled' theatre; a real checklist with the honest 'not yet' items.
ac: Remove SECURITY_CHECKS sample; show: admins count, admins with 2FA (depends on U-area 2FA story; shows 'not available yet' until then), domains verified, SSO 'on request'; 'Require 2FA for admins' toggle gated behind the dependency.
tests: Renders honest states.
stories.tech: Settings security tab; AdminMfaChallenge is platform-only (not reused).

stories.title: Close organization flow — consequence list, typed confirmation, grants end now, billing history kept
stories.story: As an owner shutting down, I want to close cleanly and know members keep their accounts.
stories.genz: Leaving is as easy as joining; nobody's data is held hostage.
ac: POST /close; UI lists who loses which item and when; members notified; invoices remain downloadable.
tests: Close ends grants; members retain accounts; CLOSED read-only.

stories.title: Sales inquiry intake for org topics (contact form → admin queue → email)
stories.story: As a prospective org buyer, I want to contact sales and get a follow-up.
stories.genz: Still useful for institutions that must talk to a human before paying.
ac: Public POST with topics organization/consultancy/consultancy-ops; admin queue with audited status; sales email.
tests: Existing SalesInquiry tests.

stories.title: /organizations honest rewrite — 'Start your workspace' CTA, per-buyer sections (bootcamps, universities, staffing), features that exist, consent story
stories.story: As a buyer, I want to understand what my team gets and start now.
stories.genz: Lead with 'your people keep their accounts and choose what you see' — that is the differentiator buyers' students will thank them for.
ac: Feature cards match shipped/P0 scope (remove 'Application automation', 'Email & response tracking' org claims, 'Approval rules'); add consent/visibility section; CTA to /org/new and demo; PLACEHOLDER numbers removed or sourced.
tests: Content/links tests; Lighthouse ≥95.

stories.title: Price calculator — people × items + setup fee, monthly total, on /organizations and /pricing
stories.story: As a buyer, I want to see what 40 Pro + 5 Autopilot costs before talking to anyone.
stories.genz: Sliders and instant totals; no 'contact us for pricing'.
ac: Reads catalog prices (API when Phase 18 exists; catalog.ts until then); shows setup + monthly; shares a link with the config.
tests: Math tests; a11y of sliders.

stories.title: Admin: orgs list/status + inquiry → 'create org for them' link (audited)
stories.story: As the platform admin, I want to see orgs and convert an inquiry into a DRAFT org invite for the buyer.
stories.genz: Shorter path from 'interested' to 'live'.
ac: Admin console orgs page (coordinate with A area); inquiry action creates DRAFT org + OWNER invite email; audited.
tests: Permission ROLE_ADMIN; audit.

stories.title: Org terms + DPA page (controller roles, consent, no-submit, no refunds/period-end, 16+)
stories.story: As a buyer, I want to read the org terms and a DPA before paying.
stories.genz: Plain-language summary on top, legal text below.
ac: /legal/organizations page linked from Screen 3 and invoices; lawyer review flagged.
tests: Links; content present.

stories.title: Mobile org shell — bottom tab bar (5), collapsed hero, DataTable → card list under md
stories.story: As an admin on a phone, I want the console to feel like an app, not a shrunken desktop.
stories.genz: Thumb-zone tabs, swipeable cards, 44px everything.
ac: BottomTabs primitive in @kiwiply/ui; OrgShell uses it <lg; OrgPageHero compact variant; DataTable gets a cards renderer prop used by all org tables; no horizontal scroll at 390px on any org route.
tests: Visual checks at 390/768/1280; e2e no-overflow assertion per route.

stories.title: Skeletons + optimistic UI for invite/assign/scope changes with rollback toasts
stories.story: As an admin, I want actions to feel instant and failures to be clear.
stories.genz: Perceived speed = trust; a rollback toast beats a spinner.
ac: loading.tsx skeletons for all org routes; optimistic updates with server reconciliation; 502 → toast + revert.
tests: Component tests for optimistic paths.

stories.title: Accessibility pass — keyboard, screen reader labels, contrast, focus order, live regions, reduced motion
stories.story: As a screen-reader user on staff, I want the console fully usable.
stories.genz: Accessibility is table stakes for the audience and for university procurement.
ac: axe clean on every org route and /join; all sheets focus-trapped; charts have text alternatives (tables); prefers-reduced-motion respected for confetti.
tests: axe in e2e; manual SR script documented.

stories.title: Dark mode for org surfaces and join flow (theme-v2 tokens)
stories.story: As a night-owl admin, I want dark mode like the rest of the app.
stories.genz: Dark mode is expected, not premium.
ac: All org routes and /join render with the dark token set; charts adapt; no hard-coded hex (lint).
tests: Visual snapshots light/dark; lint rule for hex in org-v2.
stories.tech: web/src/app/globals.css theme-v2 tokens; org-v2 components replace literal colours (e.g. #F1F4FA in OrgShell).

stories.title: E2E suite (Playwright) — create org → pay (stub) → invite → join+consent → assign → revoke → leave; CI job
stories.story: As the team, I want the walking skeleton protected end to end on every PR.
stories.genz: Ship fast without breaking the promise.
ac: Playwright added to web (dev dep, approved); mock-api extended (scripts/mock-api.mjs) or real API with billing off; runs in ci.yml on PRs to develop; 390px and 1280px projects.
tests: The suite itself; flake budget documented.

stories.title: Performance budget — org pages LCP <2.5s on 4G, rollup-backed reads, 60s in-process cache for 'today' tiles
stories.story: As an admin on mobile data, I want pages that open fast.
stories.genz: Speed is retention.
ac: Lighthouse mobile perf ≥85 on /org, /org/team, /org/analytics with 500-member fixture; server timing headers; cache per analytics.md §7.
tests: Lighthouse CI step; cache unit test.
stories.tech: Next server components + streaming; OrgMetricReadService cache.
